question: True or false: under stress, people keep repeating a practised action even after its reward has stopped appealing?
answer: True. Schwabe and Wolf stressed volunteers with a hand in ice water, then had them earn foods by choosing actions. After one food was eaten to fullness, unstressed people switched away from it; stressed people kept choosing the old action. Stress tips control from deliberate choice to habit, which is why bad days revive old ways.
move: Expect old habits to return on hard days, and plan for those days.
ask: Which old habit comes back when I am stressed, and what could I set up in advance?
trap: Stress makes people more alert, so they would notice and adjust.
source: Schwabe and Wolf, Journal of Neuroscience, 2009
reference: Schwabe L, Wolf OT, Stress prompts habit behavior in humans, Journal of Neuroscience, 2009
